headline: South Korea blocks 27 unregistered crypto exchanges, including KuCoin and MEXC

scenes.vo: South Korea is cutting off twenty-seven crypto exchanges, including Koo Coin and M E X C. Here's what changed.
Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit says these exchanges never registered. Their websites get blocked inside the country. Bit Mart and Fee mex are on the list too.
Here's why traders are watching it. Korea is a huge retail crypto market, yet only twenty-eight exchanges are registered there.
The catch. The regulator warned users of these platforms may struggle to get their money back. It says it will help with withdrawals.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether blocked sites pop up at new addresses. The regulator says it will block those too.
